extDescription.message: Blurs images that contain women and/or men, in real time, entirely on your device.

hintRelaxed.message: Fewest mistakes; may miss some people.

hintBalanced.message: Recommended balance between missing and over-blurring.

hintStrict.message: Misses the fewest people; blurs more by mistake.

noneSelected.message: Choose Women or Men to start filtering.

needAccess.message: NoHaram needs access to websites to scan their images. Nothing leaves your device.

blurWhileScanning.message: Blur images until they are scanned

blurUnknown.message: Blur people whose gender is unclear

failClosed.message: Keep images blurred if they cannot be scanned
